text:
lucas: noticed a spike in provisional tokens after today's canary. many streaming toolcalls closed with provisional>confirmed because router truncated midstream during a model fallback. short logs below.

anya: can you paste the log snippet and repro?

lucas: repro (curl): curl -s -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' -d '{"model":"opt-3b","stream":true,"input":"<long prompt>"}' https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate?route=router-canary
log excerpt: [11:45:02] req=req_a1 session=s-9 route=router-canary start streaming
[11:45:09] s-9 model_swap fallback -> smaller at 50%
[11:45:10] s-9 toolcall:router-truncate(reason=model_fallback) closed; provisional_tokens=160; confirmed_tokens=0

diego: this matches past incidents. we need an internal confirm API so router can tell ledger whether session finalized or was truncated. relying on client confirms is flaky.

anya: proposal: POST /internal/sessions/{id}/confirm with payload as JSON string: '{"confirm":"true|false","final_tokens":"N","last_seq":"M","reason":"completed|truncated|client_eof|error"}' ; idempotent by (session_id,last_seq). ledger should accept confirm=false and mark finalized_at so provisional stops showing as open.

infra-bot: auto-alert created for routes with provisional_ratio > 0.2: TICKET-4211.

deploy-bot: deploy: router-canary -> 10% (11:45) :rocket:

lucas: action items:
- eng-router: implement internal confirm endpoint + idempotency
- ledger: store closed_reason and finalized_at, accept confirm=false semantics
- infra: add metric session_finalization_lag_ms and provisional_to_confirmed_ratio per-route
- devex: add tentative/provisional filter in console

anya: i'll draft the router PR and include idempotency tests. assigning to diego/lucas.
